## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes, why it is needed, and any context or design decisions.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI / Styling enhancement (design changes or theme adjustments)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (updates to README, docs, guides)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧹 Refactoring / Code cleanup

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Unit tests passed (`npm test`)
- [ ] Typecheck passed without errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Tested manually in the browser (Public site + Admin panel)
- [ ] Tested responsive layout on mobile/tablet viewports

## Screenshots / Screen Recordings (if applicable)
Please attach before/after screenshots or screen recordings for UI modifications.

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the neo-brutalist style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation where appropriate
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors
